left.raw_text: Anaphylactic reaction to a previous dose of TIV(trivalent influenza vaccine)
Known IgE( Immunoglobulin E)-mediated hypersensitivity to eggs
manifested as hives, swelling of the mouth and throat, difficulty in breathing, hypotension, or shock
Guillain-Barré syndrome within eight weeks of a previous influenza vaccine
Patients who have had influenza vaccine in two of the three previous years
